name: dsh-agent-pipeline-canvas
description: Local DSH Web composition plugin: a visual agent-pipeline canvas as a persistent 'Pipelines' view tab in every session. Drag an Agent from a palette onto the canvas, reposition nodes, and connect outputs to inputs with directed edges. Holds the graph as structured data and validates it as a DAG (cycles, self/duplicate/malformed connections, missing agents or ports). A minimal sequential runner runs the snapshot by delegating each agent to the harness's subagents service in topological order, passing outputs downstream and returning the { outputs } result. Parallel execution, retries, conditions, loops, cancellation, and live visualization are not implemented yet.

scripts.test: tsx test/validate.test.ts && tsx test/execution.test.ts && tsx test/message.test.ts && tsx test/runner.test.ts && tsx test/runs.test.ts
scripts.sync: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && rsync -a --delete --exclude .git --exclude node_modules ./ ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-agent-pipeline-canvas/ && echo 'Synced to the profile — hard-refresh the browser tab; restart the web profile only if host routes changed.'
